messages:
anya: Quick async standup from me — what I did / blockers / today

sam: quick note: pushed spec draft for the new quota meter to PR #412, needs product review

anya: thanks @sam, will read after standup. What I did: finalized latency SLO writeup for routing policies, added examples for dedicated fallback behaviors.

kevin: blocker: I hit an edge in the canary routing test where fallback chooses a higher-cost variant for 1p requests. Repro steps in thread below.

anya: noted, kevin — can you paste the simple repro and I'll triage with infra later today?

kevin: repro: request routing table shows two matches, policy prefers lower-latency but cost scoring gets higher weight in Canary. ```policy: {latency_weight:0.7, cost_weight:0.6}``` -> leads to wrong pick. I think default normalization is off.

lia: FYI, UX copy for quota alerts is ready. I left three microcopy variants in the doc — @sam which one do you prefer for the dashboard?

sam: Variant B is clearer to me, but open to a tweak: change "high usage" -> "near quota".

anya: blockers: none blocking launch but small things to finish: (1) finalize rollout gating criteria, (2) confirm canary traffic window with SRE, (3) merge quota meter PRs.

mike: today I'll: 1) pair with kevin on the routing normalization; 2) cut a canary config patch; 3) smoke test embed cache under burst.

jen: reminder: security review scheduled 2pm PT. If you have config snippets (especially KMS/HSM fields) please post in the review doc before 11am.

anya: prioritization ask: can we keep quota meter UX and routing tweak in the same release? I think routing normalization is small but could affect canary results. My preference: ship routing fix first, then UX in the same minor release if tests pass. Thoughts?

sam: agree with sequence. Routing fix first -> run canary -> if stable, include UX and quota meter.

kevin: thumbs up. I'll target a hotfix branch for the normalization and tag @mike when it's ready.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window created for 2026-03-18T22:00Z — duration 60m, targets: dedicated-pool-west-1, fallback: opt-low-cost-variant.

anya: great — owners: kevin + mike for routing, sam for quota-UX, lia to shepherd copy, jen security. I'll update the roadmap board and mark the release as "routing-first".

sam: one more: code review pinged for PR #412 (quota meter) and PR #415 (dashboard alerts). If anyone can spare a quick look that would help unblock merge. :pray:

anya: thanks team. If no surprises, I'll do a short async check-in after the canary results.

mike: copied, will post test run logs in the infra channel after smoke tests. :hammer_and_wrench:

jen: security will skim configs, ping if we need any redlines.

kevin: posting repro and small patch now.

anya: end of thread — short and actionable. :white_check_mark:
